applies_why: The judge text rules that the relevant wording and application were answered, which triggers K-G4's instruction that answered verses are not counted as unanswered witnesses.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
room: unanswered witness — reading 1: only a verse counted as an unanswered witness needs the quoted pressed sentence; reading 2: any verse mention must be treated as unanswered unless disproven. The judge text says answered.
why: The judge text says both the challenger and defender answered, so under K-G4 those answered verses are not counted as unanswered witnesses.
